special_traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
special_traits.description:
If the devil dies outside the
Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

special_traits.name: Magic Resistance
special_traits.description:
The devil has Advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The devil makes two Claw attacks and one
Infernal Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8
+ 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Infernal Sting
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit:
15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.
